claims.text: PaymentService exposes the Charge RPC whose request combines Money and CreditCardInfo, and whose response supplies a transaction_id.
The declared PaymentService interface describes message shape, but this interface alone does not prove that any request succeeded.
The charge call sends amount and credit-card information to PaymentService.Charge, where RPC errors return to the caller and successful replies expose a transaction identifier.
